public import Conjugacy
@[expose] public section
namespace ComputationalHodge.ArclengthSpectrum
open ComputationalHodge.CircleHodge ComputationalHodge.MetricHodge
open ComputationalHodge.Poisson ComputationalHodge.Arclength

theorem inverse_shift (ρ : RegularDensity) (x : ℝ) (n : ℤ) :
    inverse ρ.val (x + n) = inverse ρ.val x + n := by
  apply (coordinate_strictMono ρ.val).injective
  rw [coordinate_inverse, coordinate_shift, coordinate_inverse]

theorem coordinate_circle_periodic (ρ : RegularDensity) :
    Function.Periodic (fun x : ℝ => (coordinate ρ.val x : CircleHodge.Circle)) 1 := by
  intro x
  change (coordinate ρ.val (x + 1) : CircleHodge.Circle) = (coordinate ρ.val x : CircleHodge.Circle)
  have h : coordinate ρ.val (x + 1) = coordinate ρ.val x + 1 := by
    simpa using coordinate_shift ρ.val x 1
  rw [h]
  exact AddCircle.coe_add_period 1 _

theorem inverse_circle_periodic (ρ : RegularDensity) :
    Function.Periodic (fun x : ℝ => (inverse ρ.val x : CircleHodge.Circle)) 1 := by
  intro x
  change (inverse ρ.val (x + 1) : CircleHodge.Circle) = (inverse ρ.val x : CircleHodge.Circle)
  have h : inverse ρ.val (x + 1) = inverse ρ.val x + 1 := by
    simpa using inverse_shift ρ x 1
  rw [h]
  exact AddCircle.coe_add_period 1 _

/-- The actual based quotient-circle homeomorphism induced by arclength. -/
noncomputable def circleCoordinate (ρ : RegularDensity) : CircleHodge.Circle ≃ₜ CircleHodge.Circle where
  toFun := (coordinate_circle_periodic ρ).lift
  invFun := (inverse_circle_periodic ρ).lift
  left_inv := by
    intro q
    induction q using Quotient.inductionOn with | _ x =>
    change ((inverse ρ.val (coordinate ρ.val x) : ℝ) : CircleHodge.Circle) = (x : CircleHodge.Circle)
    rw [inverse_coordinate]
  right_inv := by
    intro q
    induction q using Quotient.inductionOn with | _ x =>
    change ((coordinate ρ.val (inverse ρ.val x) : ℝ) : CircleHodge.Circle) = (x : CircleHodge.Circle)
    rw [coordinate_inverse]
  continuous_toFun := ((AddCircle.continuous_mk' (1 : ℝ)).comp (coordinate_contDiff_two ρ).continuous).quotient_liftOn' _
  continuous_invFun := ((AddCircle.continuous_mk' (1 : ℝ)).comp (inverse_contDiff_two ρ).continuous).quotient_liftOn' _

theorem circleCoordinate_mk (ρ : RegularDensity) (x : ℝ) :
    circleCoordinate ρ (x : CircleHodge.Circle) = (coordinate ρ.val x : CircleHodge.Circle) := rfl
theorem circleCoordinate_zero (ρ : RegularDensity) : circleCoordinate ρ 0 = 0 := by
  change (coordinate ρ.val 0 : CircleHodge.Circle) = 0
  rw [coordinate_zero]
  rfl

theorem pullback_apply (ρ : RegularDensity) (u : Coefficient) (q : CircleHodge.Circle) :
    pullback ρ u q = u (circleCoordinate ρ q) := by
  induction q using Quotient.inductionOn with | _ x => rfl

/-- Pullback has the inverse induced by the actual inverse coordinate. -/
noncomputable def inversePullback (ρ : RegularDensity) (u : Coefficient) : Coefficient where
  toFun q := u ((circleCoordinate ρ).symm q)
  continuous_toFun := u.continuous.comp (circleCoordinate ρ).symm.continuous

theorem pullback_inversePullback (ρ : RegularDensity) (u : Coefficient) :
    pullback ρ (inversePullback ρ u) = u := by
  ext q
  rw [pullback_apply]
  change u ((circleCoordinate ρ).symm (circleCoordinate ρ q)) = u q
  rw [Homeomorph.symm_apply_apply]

theorem inversePullback_pullback (ρ : RegularDensity) (u : Coefficient) :
    inversePullback ρ (pullback ρ u) = u := by
  ext q
  change pullback ρ u ((circleCoordinate ρ).symm q) = u q
  rw [pullback_apply, Homeomorph.apply_symm_apply]

noncomputable def inversePullbackC2 (ρ : RegularDensity) (u : C2Coefficient) : C2Coefficient :=
  ⟨inversePullback ρ u.val, by
    change ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun x => cover u.val (inverse ρ.val x))
    exact (show ContDiff ℝ 2 (cover u.val) from u.property).comp (inverse_contDiff_two ρ)⟩

/-- The inverse is constructed from the inverse arclength coordinate. -/
noncomputable def pullbackC2Equiv (ρ : RegularDensity) : C2Coefficient ≃ C2Coefficient where
  toFun := pullbackC2 ρ
  invFun := inversePullbackC2 ρ
  left_inv := by
    intro u
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact inversePullback_pullback ρ u.val
  right_inv := by
    intro u
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact pullback_inversePullback ρ u.val
end ComputationalHodge.ArclengthSpectrum

noncomputable def geometricCosine (ρ : RegularDensity) : C2Coefficient := pullbackC2 ρ cosineC2
noncomputable def geometricFrequency (ρ : RegularDensity) : ℝ :=
  (mean ρ.val.val)⁻¹ ^ 2 * frequency

theorem geometricFrequency_positive (ρ : RegularDensity) : 0 < geometricFrequency ρ := by
  unfold geometricFrequency
  exact mul_pos (sq_pos_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr (mean_pos ρ.val))) frequency_positive

theorem geometricCosine_eigen (ρ : RegularDensity) :
    laplacian ρ (geometricCosine ρ) = geometricFrequency ρ • (geometricCosine ρ).val := by
  rw [show geometricCosine ρ = pullbackC2 ρ cosineC2 from rfl, laplacian_pullback, cosine_eigen]
  ext q
  induction q using Quotient.inductionOn with | _ x =>
  change (mean ρ.val.val)⁻¹ ^ 2 * cover (pullback ρ (frequency • cosine)) x =
    geometricFrequency ρ * cover (pullback ρ cosine) x
  rw [cover_pullback, cover_pullback]
  change (mean ρ.val.val)⁻¹ ^ 2 * (frequency * cover cosine (coordinate ρ.val x)) = _
  unfold geometricFrequency
  ring

theorem geometricCosine_nonzero (ρ : RegularDensity) : (geometricCosine ρ).val ≠ 0 := by
  intro h
  have he := congrArg (fun f : Coefficient => f 0) h
  change cover (pullback ρ cosine) 0 = 0 at he
  rw [cover_pullback, coordinate_zero, cosine_cover] at he
  norm_num at he

theorem geometricCosine_mean_zero (ρ : RegularDensity) :
    weightedMean ρ (geometricCosine ρ).val = 0 := by
  have h := weightedMean_laplacian ρ (geometricCosine ρ)
  rw [geometricCosine_eigen, weightedMean_smul] at h
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h).resolve_left (ne_of_gt (geometricFrequency_positive ρ))

noncomputable def geometricCosineMode (ρ : RegularDensity) : Domain ρ :=
  ⟨geometricCosine ρ, geometricCosine_mean_zero ρ⟩

/-- The actual arclength mode supplies a nonzero period-compatible obstruction for every density. -/
theorem geometricCosine_obstruction (ρ : RegularDensity) :
    (geometricCosine ρ).val ≠ 0 ∧
    (∀ p : Trace 0 0, lineIntegral (ρ.val.val * (geometricCosine ρ).val) (fromTrace p) = 0) ∧
    (∀ p : Trace 0 0, period p (meanHarmonic (ρ.val.val * (geometricCosine ρ).val)).val = 0) ∧
    ¬ ∃ u : C2Coefficient,
      laplacian ρ u - geometricFrequency ρ • u.val = (geometricCosine ρ).val :=
  ⟨geometricCosine_nonzero ρ, (mode_periods ρ (geometricCosineMode ρ)).1,
    (mode_periods ρ (geometricCosineMode ρ)).2,
    mode_obstructed ρ (geometricFrequency ρ) (geometricCosine ρ)
      (geometricCosine_nonzero ρ) (geometricCosine_eigen ρ)⟩
end ComputationalHodge.ArclengthSpectrum

public import CircleCoordinate
@[expose] public section
namespace ComputationalHodge.ArclengthSpectrum
open ComputationalHodge.CircleHodge ComputationalHodge.MetricHodge
open ComputationalHodge.Poisson ComputationalHodge.Arclength

theorem cosine_half : cosine ((1 / 2 : ℝ) : CircleHodge.Circle) = -1 := by
  have h := cosine_cover (1 / 2)
  change cosine ((1 / 2 : ℝ) : CircleHodge.Circle) = _ at h
  rw [show 2 * Real.pi * (1 / 2 : ℝ) = Real.pi by ring, Real.cos_pi] at h
  exact h

/-- A positive, nonconstant C¹ density from the existing circle construction. -/
noncomputable def sampleDensity : RegularDensity := ⟨⟨constant 2 + cosine, by
  intro q
  have h : |cosine q| ≤ 1 := by simpa [cosine] using Complex.abs_re_le_norm (AddCircle.toCircle q : ℂ)
  change 0 < 2 + cosine q
  linarith [(abs_le.mp h).1]⟩, by
  change ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun x => 2 + cover cosine x)
  exact contDiff_const.add (c2_c1 cosineC2)⟩

theorem sampleDensity_nonconstant : ¬ ∃ c : ℝ, sampleDensity.val.val = constant c := by
  rintro ⟨c, h⟩
  have h0 := congrArg (fun f : Coefficient => f 0) h
  have h1 := congrArg (fun f : Coefficient => f ((1 / 2 : ℝ) : CircleHodge.Circle)) h
  change 2 + cosine 0 = c at h0
  change 2 + cosine ((1 / 2 : ℝ) : CircleHodge.Circle) = c at h1
  rw [cosine_zero] at h0
  rw [cosine_half] at h1
  linarith

/-- If the real arclength coordinate were the identity, the density would be constant. -/
theorem coordinate_id_implies_constant (ρ : RegularDensity) (h : coordinate ρ.val = id) :
    ρ.val.val = constant (mean ρ.val.val) := by
  ext q
  induction q using Quotient.inductionOn with | _ x =>
  change cover ρ.val.val x = mean ρ.val.val
  have hd := congrArg (fun f : ℝ → ℝ => deriv f x) h
  rw [(coordinate_hasDerivAt ρ.val x).deriv, (hasDerivAt_id x).deriv] at hd
  exact (div_eq_one_iff_eq (ne_of_gt (mean_pos ρ.val))).mp hd

theorem sample_coordinate_nonidentity : coordinate sampleDensity.val ≠ id := by
  intro h
  exact sampleDensity_nonconstant ⟨mean sampleDensity.val.val, coordinate_id_implies_constant sampleDensity h⟩
end ComputationalHodge.ArclengthSpectrum

theorem geometricCosine_on_trace (ρ : RegularDensity) (p : Trace 0 0) (t : unitInterval) :

  change cover (pullback ρ cosine) (actualLift p t) = _
  rw [cover_pullback, cosine_cover]
